artist.name: TRAFFICC
artist.bio: TRAFFICC is a New Delhi DJ who hosts the monthly show Rush Hour on boxout.fm. His sets draw on 80s and 90s rave culture and move through electro, techno, breakbeat and hardcore, with hip-hop, afrobeat and dancehall mixed in. He has also produced, including a collaboration with Monophonik.

eras.sound: High-energy electro, techno, breakbeat and hardcore sets
